test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All phones are cars.

All phones are lights.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some cars are lights.

(II) All lights are phones.
solution:
Statements:**
All phones are cars.

All phones are lights.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acd659c585f4fd3db2ca5949758aca8629f68853603b08c065628692a9342bc9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some cars are lights. - Follow** (Because, All phones are cars and All phones are lights, which means some cars being phones are lights.)

(II) All lights are phones. - Does not follow (Because, All phones are lights, which means some lights are phones.)

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
